reason: The lab report and the empty-box guarantee are nice, but it is one form of magnesium and I keep seeing blends with several forms in one capsule for about the same money. Nothing here hits a problem I have right now, so I would just keep scrolling.
objection: Why only magnesium bisglycinate when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? And it never says what it does for me.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video where someone like me says it helped her sleep, plus a clear reason why one form is better than a mix.
